caption: One sentence, "Rao joined TCS in Pune last Monday", becomes three triples: (Rao, works_for, TCS), (Rao, works_in, Pune) and (Rao, joined_on, Monday), one arrow each. Every arrow is one row of the knowledge base, and the shared node Rao is what lets a query walk from person to employer to city to date.

spec.aria: A directed graph with node Rao (PER) on the left joined by three labelled arrows: works_for to TCS (ORG), works_in to Pune (LOC) and joined_on to Monday (DATE).
